sections.section: Bias Analysis in Unconditional Image Generative Models (p. 1–29)

omissions.source: While diversity metrics typically assess the coverage of modes in the generated distribution, bias evaluation should focus on the relative proportions of these modes.

In CelebA dataset, the training and validation sets contain the faces of distinct sets of celebrities. In DeepFashion dataset, the training and validation samples are split randomly. The distribution difference between training and validation sets of CelebA is larger than that of DeepFashion.

We don't see the discriminative biases being amplified for most attributes according to Figs. 16 and 15 comparing the training ground truth probability and the validation classifier-predicted probability.
